name: manual_11baf3
claim: When a concurrent agent commits directly to the same working directory/branch mid-review, verify by reading actual diffs and running the actual test suite before crediting or trusting any of its claimed fixes -- never trust a commit message's claimed test count.

decisions.notes: Discovered live during a /autoplan Eng-phase review on orama-system's hermes-openclaw-graft-audit-plan.md (2026-08-06): a 'Relay Cursor Agent' committed 5 commits directly to the exact branch/working-directory in use, implementing fixes matching the review's own in-progress task IDs (T-ENG-1 etc). Verified by reading diffs + running pytest (38/38 passed, matching the claimed count) before crediting any of it as done -- this is the productive counterpart to the 'concurrent agent collisions' risk already in memory, but the discipline (verify, don't trust) is identical either way.
